thread:
maria: quick sync: we're seeing too much duplicated golden data across probers. two options: a catalog service vs keep-as-is. thoughts?

ajay: catalog gives a single canonical id per gold set. nice for cross-model drift diffs and promos.

linda: careful about what we store. full payloads (in+expected) balloon storage. maybe store canonical normalized input + small sketch of expected (hash + sample)?

ken: did a back-of-envelope: avg sample 12KB, 2k samples/model for deepbench in active pool ~300 models => ~7.0TB raw. with zstd and dedupe ~1.8TB. still non-trivial for downloads during CI.

bench-bot: observational: 60% of probers use the same 150 golds repeatedly. only ~10 gold sets cover majority.

sara: practical tradeoffs:
- central: easier to rotate bad gold and patch; one ACL surface; simpler metric joins.
- local: probers can canary quickly and avoid breaking offline workflows that expect repo-local assets.

maria: we need stable telemetry IDs that don't drift when prober code changes. catalog can own immutable ids.

ajay: hybrid: catalog stores canonical sets + immutable ids; probers can declare local overrides that shadow the canonical for limited windows. telemetry tags emit both canonical_id and override_id when present.

linda: shadow semantics need to include metadata: reason, owner, expires_at. also must surface how an override can be promoted back to canonical.

ken: propose minimal API: 
- GET /gold/{id} -> metadata + signed url for tarball
- POST /gold -> creates new canonical with immediate immutable id
- POST /gold/{id}/promote -> mark override promoted (only after review)

infra-bot: signed-url infra + rate-limits exist; will need a signed-url cache for CI runners to avoid repeated calls.

devbot: CLI: `ri gold pull --id ID --dest path` and `ri gold shadow --id ID --reason "..." --expires 7d` to register override. will sketch.

bench-bot: canonicalization rules suggestion: store raw_input, tokenized_text (model/tokenizer-variant normalized), and expected_output_hash. that will let us run quick diffs and avoid false positives due to tokenizer variance.

sara: rollout proposal:
1) implement read-only catalog + assign ids behind ff
2) migrate top-10 gold sets referenced by existing probes to catalog and update codepaths to prefer catalog lookup
3) enable shadowing with strict expiry and telemetry that emits both ids
4) run a 14-day comparison window to check FP/alert drift and prober latency impact

ajay: success metrics: duplicate storage drops by >70%, update time for gold sets <24h, no increase in FP alerts over baseline.

maria: action items: ajay to write API spec (read/write + signed url flow) by Fri EOD; ken to run a dedupe+download-time sim by Tue; devbot to open CLI PR; sara to draft rollout playbook incl. promotion review checklist. i'll coordinate and add a `gold-compat` linter in the backlog.

linda: optional: enforce tokenizer variant at ingest with a lint rule. helps reduce surprises.

maria: thanks everyone. will follow up on the RFC channel with a short doc.
